name: PTU Combat Vicious + Hone Claws

ability.name: Vicious
choices: Gain another Standard Action this round.
Increase Critical Hit Range on all attacks by +2 for the remainder of the encounter.

runtime_policy.trigger_window: opens only after a source-matched Hone Claws use; expires after another Move or the round/Scene/Day boundary
runtime_policy.extra_standard: adds one Standard Action token to the current turn; the shared action API may spend it as Standard or convert it to Swift/Shift under the normal PTU conversion rule
runtime_policy.full_action: bonus Standard does not satisfy Full Action in v1; Full Action still requires the base Standard + Shift pair
runtime_policy.critical_range: records +2 as controlled-Pokemon combat state until the Pokémon leaves the current Combat session; hit/critical outcome remains manually confirmed
runtime_policy.frequency: one Vicious activation per Scene; resource-only Undo does not rewind the selected effect and an applied-effect marker prevents double activation in that Scene

source_conflicts_observed_while_selectin.Electrodash: Core: Scene – Free Action, Sprint as Swift; Feb 2016 playtest: Scene x2 – Swift Action, Sprint as Free plus additional bonuses. Rejected for this pass.
source_conflicts_observed_while_selectin.Quick Curl: Core and Feb 2016 playtest contain conflicting definitions. Existing Quick Curl automation remains Core-signature-gated and therefore disables itself when the active Ruleset definition differs.

non_goals: No automatic determination of Critical Hits.
